<h2>O que esta prova garante, e o que nã: What this proof guarantees, and what it does not
<p>Ela prova que os valores lacrados nos: It proves that the values sealed in the envelopes are exactly the public list, in another order. It does not reveal who has which value, and it does not say whether the values themselves are true: that depends on whoever publishes them. We use the “cut and choose” technique because it can be followed step by step; real systems usually use compact proofs, equivalent but far more technical.
